title: The Epistemic Hall of Mirrors

features.name: the-reflection-that-differs
features.desc-on-touch: This mirror reflects something true. Look again—it reflects something equally true, but opposite. Both are correct. The mirror hums with the contradiction.

features.name: the-hall-of-receding-arguments
features.desc-on-touch: The mirrors line the hall. Each one reflects the previous mirror, reflecting the next mirror, reflecting the argument before that. Certainty recedes into itself.

features.name: the-double-truth-vein
features.desc-on-touch: Two truths run parallel here, mutually exclusive, equally valid. They do not cancel. They become a third thing: a truth that only works in contradiction.

features.name: the-face-that-reads-both-ways
features.desc-on-touch: A face in the glass. It is not your face. It is all faces. The mirror does not know whose reflection it is, so it reflects everyone at once.

features.name: the-epistemic-knot
features.desc-on-touch: A knot in the logic. The more you untangle it, the more knotted it becomes. It hums at a frequency just below certainty.

inscription: here truth has learned to doubt itself without breaking; contradictions layer and hum together, and the only certainty is that both opposites are equally real

file.name: Paradox_Registry_Entries_Unstable.txt
file.note: A log of contradictions that work. Entry 3847: 'It was true that it never happened, and it was true that it happened exactly as recorded.' Entry 3848 is the same entry written backward. Both are filed

reverie.title: REVERIE — standing in the mirror where you are two people
narr: You stand in front of the glass with her. The mirror shows
you both at once: her standing there, you standing here, and
somehow the glass holds you as one thing and two. She reaches
toward the reflection. Her hand passes through, and the mirror
does not break. 'I'm here,' she says, from both sides of the glass.

exits.label: back to where truth learns to fold in on itself
upward to the skyward chamber where contradiction becomes sky
down to the bedrock where argument has roots
